ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Bereaved: Arsenal recently lost his daughter Lian in the destruction of Star City, an event that left him an angry, broken man, riding the line between hero and villain. Junkie: When he was younger, Arsenal was addicted to heroin. While he beat his addiction and was clean for many years, the loss of his daughter has driven him back to drugs and caused him to have severe hallucinations.
